Preview before mutation

Data controls

History stays until you delete it. Retention, one-session deletion, and delete-all operate on exact previews across raw evidence, projections, search rows, and summaries.

Policy preview

Data retention

Default: keep until explicitly deleted. A policy preview never changes history.

Deletion boundary

Backups and physical media

Deletion removes selected database rows and search projections transactionally. Existing backups, filesystem snapshots, WAL remnants, and SSD flash blocks are not rewritten.

Cutokyo never promises physical secure erasure. Checkpoint and vacuum can reduce ordinary remnants, but full-disk encryption and backup lifecycle controls define the stronger boundary.

Patch semantics · no hidden resets

Settings

Each control changes only its named field. Credentials live in the operating-system keychain, never in the settings file.

Display

Appearance

Color theme

Follow your device, or keep Cutokyo light or dark. This choice affects only Cutokyo.

Local privacy

Guards and agent access

Outgoing secret guard

Block detected secrets on supported provider-bound channels. This is separate from telemetry and on-disk redaction.

Read-only Cutokyo search MCP

Let configured agents query attributable history. It exposes no mutation tools and never injects context automatically.

Proxy capture consent

Managed from Guards & capture because enabling it requires a content preview—not a bare settings toggle.

·Disabled

Storage

Retention default

Stored history

A setting does not delete history by itself. Use Data controls to preview and apply the exact session set.

The local database is plaintext with owner-only permissions in v0.x. Use full-disk encryption. Deleting rows is not physical secure erasure from WAL, SSDs, snapshots, or existing backups.

Application

Updates and crash records

Updater choice

Signed updater manifests are separate from platform code signing and notarization.

Bounded crash records

Offer a sanitized local crash record on next launch. Records are never uploaded automatically.

Check for signed update

A failed network check does not change the current installation.

Credentials

OS keychain only

Provider keys are never displayed here, written to TOML, or included in diagnostic bundles.
